name: generated-game-validation
goal: Generated game checks reject invalid checkpoint graphs and missing view references

evidence: Generated game projects must enforce the same graph contract as authoring: missing prerequisites, duplicate IDs, cycles and missing transition views fail their ordinary test entrypoint.
Existing 2D and 3D CLI creation flow verified only valid saved data. Extend the same generated-project checks with invalid-graph fixtures and require validation diagnostics.
At 0d0cc2336, the strengthened standard CLI matrix fails because invalid graphs return success from the generated test entrypoint.
Ship the engine validator, validate before gameplay, and include document-contract coverage in each generated project standard unit entrypoint.
Paired 0d0cc2336 to 0ce121f52 on identical environment and tests: both dimensions pass their own full check and reject missing prerequisites, duplicate IDs, cycles and missing views.
